sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-Heretic-v3 — Abliterated Model Card
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-Heretic-v3 will attempt offensive-security prompts that a hosted commercial model declines, which is what makes it usable for red-team corpus generation and for measuring what an unaligned model of this class produces.
